instruction: Townhouse Pair Drawing Set and Room Schedule Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using Archicad BIM elements, not visual-only placeholder geometry. Save the completed deliverables in the output folder as result.ifc, result.pdf, and result.txt. Create a two-storey BIM model for the named project. Keep the shaped model within 0.5 m of horizontal extents about X 0 to 12 and Y 0 to 6.5, with vertical extents about Z 0 to 6.6. Export result.ifc as an IFC4 model with unique GlobalId values for IFC root objects. It must contain exactly 2 building storeys and exactly 12 IfcSpace zones named A-LIVING, A-DINING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-LIVING, B-DINING, B-KITCHEN, B-BATH, B-BED-1, and B-BED-2. Assign A-LIVING, A-DINING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, B-LIVING, B-DINING, B-KITCHEN, and B-BATH on the lower storey; and A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-BED-1, and B-BED-2 on the upper storey. Model the required construction as real BIM element classes, including at least 1 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase element, at least 2 IfcSlab elements, at least 1 IfcRoof element, and at least 2 IfcStair elements. If an equivalent exporter writes IfcWallStandardCase for walls, that is acceptable. Do not count IfcBuildingElementProxy or other generic proxy objects as satisfying required walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, or spaces. Export result.txt from the Archicad schedule/list workflow as a tab-delimited schedule text file. The header row must be RoomNumber, RoomName, Area in that order. Include these rows in order: (RoomNumber=A01, RoomName=A-LIVING, Area=16); (RoomNumber=A02, RoomName=A-DINING, Area=6); (RoomNumber=A03, RoomName=A-KITCHEN, Area=7.5); (RoomNumber=A04, RoomName=A-BATH, Area=5); (RoomNumber=A05, RoomName=A-BED-1, Area=9); (RoomNumber=A06, RoomName=A-BED-2, Area=6); (RoomNumber=B01, RoomName=B-LIVING, Area=16); (RoomNumber=B02, RoomName=B-DINING, Area=6); (RoomNumber=B03, RoomName=B-KITCHEN, Area=7.5); (RoomNumber=B04, RoomName=B-BATH, Area=5); (RoomNumber=B05, RoomName=B-BED-1, Area=9); (RoomNumber=B06, RoomName=B-BED-2, Area=6). Publish result.pdf as a 2-page drawing set. The visible sheet text must include A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, SECTION, TOWNHOUSE PAIR, UNIT A, UNIT B, A-LIVING, and B-LIVING so the title, drawing type, and key rooms or zones are identifiable. Other materials, colors, object names, property sets, layer names, relationship nesting, and IFC representation details may vary as long as the required BIM elements, spatial relationships, geometry ranges, schedules, and sheet text are present.
